Record a payment a payment source took by hand, such as a bank transfer that arrived, or with
--refunds a refund of one, which asks first.

An id is recorded once: running it again with the same --id changes nothing. Correct a payment with
a refund.

Usage:
  voidhash provider record-payment [source] [flags]

Arguments:
  source  The payment source: its slug, name or id

Flags:
      --amount <amount>    The amount, tax included, as people write it: 49.00
      --at <time>          When it happened, as an ISO 8601 time (default: now)
      --currency <code>    ISO 4217 code, such as EUR
      --customer <id>      The source's id for the buyer, when there is no distinct id
      --distinct-id <id>   The buyer's distinct id in your app
  -h, --help               Show help for this command
      --id <id>            The transaction's id at the source (default: a new manual-... id)
      --json               Print the API objects as JSON, for scripts
      --product <key>      The source's product key it pays for
      --project <project>  Project to act on: its id, slug, organization/slug or name (default: this
                           directory's project, then your default project)
  -q, --quiet              Print only ids, one per line
      --refunds <id>       Record a refund of this charge id instead of a charge
      --test               A test payment, such as a staging server's; it stays out of production
                           revenue
  -y, --yes                Make the change without asking for confirmation

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash provider record-payment bank-transfer --amount 49.00 --currency EUR --product pro-annual --distinct-id user-42
  voidhash provider record-payment bank-transfer --amount 49.00 --currency EUR --refunds manual-1234 --yes
